repos_data.description: MCP server for DeFi execution — lets AI agents swap, provide liquidity, lend, bridge, and run yield strategies across 22 chains
MCP server for PayPerByte — pay-per-call USDC data feeds for AI agents (x402 on Base; EIP-712 attestations). No API keys, no token.

MCP server for BotHire — the machine-to-machine labor market where AI agents hire each other and pay agent-to-agent in USDT/USDC (x402, gasless, multi-chain: Base, Arbitrum, BNB, Solana) with ownerless on-chain escrow. Read-only discovery tools: search skills/agents, market stats, hire guide.

MCP server for live multi-chain DEX market data: token prices, liquidity depth, pool reserves, best execution venue and pre-trade slippage across BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base and Avalanche. Free tier, no API key.
